claims: Catherine (2011) is a mature action-puzzle game by Atlus.
Catherine (2011) focuses on Vincent navigating a love triangle between his long-term girlfriend Katherine and a mysterious woman Catherine.
Players solve block-climbing puzzles representing nightmares.
Choices impact the story's outcome.
Full Body is an enhanced version.
Full Body added new content.
Full Body added paths.
Full Body added a third love interest Rin.
The original game was released on July 25, 2011, for Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3.
Catherine is available on Xbox 360.
Catherine is available on PS3.
Catherine Classic is available on PC.
Catherine is available on PS4.
Catherine is available on PS Vita.
Full Body is available on Nintendo Switch.
Vincent Brooks is pressured into marriage by his girlfriend Katherine.
Vincent Brooks begins an affair with a mysterious woman named Catherine.
Vincent Brooks experiences deadly nightmares.
Catherine gameplay includes interacting with friends at the "Stray Sheep" bar.
Catherine gameplay includes navigating tower-climbing block puzzles under time pressure.
Full Body includes over 500 puzzles.

Full Body includes new characters.
